reviews.text: I had multiple problems with my pool at a house I just purchased. Don visited to diagnose the problem and scheduled service efficiently and quickly. He fixed a supplemental waterfall pump, two valves, installed a new pool heater, and added a Polaris pool cleaner. All of this at a reasonable and very fair price. Also his little dog kept guard and kept everyone safe all afternoon. I recommend Pool and Spa Etc without reservation!
reviews.author: Bari and Bots Hulen

reviews.text: Don has done work on our pool and rental hot tub for several years. In addition to regular filter maintenance, his ability to repair vs replace has saved us money as has his ability to trouble shoot. He's very busy so scheduling is sometimes difficult but his prices are worth the wait. We highly recommend Don!
reviews.author: Karen Eschliman

reviews.text: We called at 4pm due to a noisy motor & diatomaceous earth spilling back into our pool. Don came out the next day & was able to assess & quote us for the replacement of the motor & manifold. He was back the next day to replace both & completely cleaned the filter grid for less than $400 total. The motor alone was around that on amazon. Great customer service! We highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Sabrina M

reviews.text: Have always had excellent service from Don for both regular/emergency repairs and regular maintenance.  Plus they are one of the few retailers of the best brand of pool chemicals - BioGuard "Silk Guard" chlorine tablets (your water actually will sparkle) and "Smart Shock".  The chemicals may cost a little more but you won't use as much.  I've had four pools over 40 years experience and Pool & Spa is the best I've ever dealt with.
reviews.author: Robert Diana

reviews.text: I have been a customer of Pool and Spa Etc. Since August of 2016 and I've always had great service and excellent customer service.   Don did a great job of cleaning my pool and continues to clean it monthly with no issues.   Also, if I ever have a problem I can call him and know my concern will be addressed quickly and efficiently.  I highly recommend Don and his people at Pool and Spa Etc!  From a loyal customer in Hillsboro.
reviews.author: Paul Michaud

reviews.text: In response to Ms Silva. She was made aware of our service call policy prior to us coming to her home. A licensed, insured technician came to her home. Yes, a switch was turned on and the pump worked. Sometimes its something simple. Costs to come out were incurred. Employee, fuel etc. We did send Ms Silva a partial rebate of 36$ the same day of the service call, in an effort towards good will.
reviews.author: John Morcillo

reviews.text: Worst customer experience I have ever had. I had an appt between 8-9 AM. At 9:30 I called and they told me the owner would not be there until 2 PM. I had problems with my waterfall feature in my pool not working. John, the owner shows up and presses the "on" button and my waterfall feature works. He charged me $85.00. If you do not want to be taken advantage of, call another company.
reviews.author: Emily Silvia

reviews.text: Don Finley was excellent fixed our problem and found a couple other issues which no other company had.  We will be using this company in the future.  Trust is everything and Don proved we can trust him and the company.
reviews.author: Laurie Black

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The business has a long history (33 years) and an A+ BBB rating with no complaints. Positive reviews are detailed and span over a decade. The single negative review is specific and credible, and the owner's public response is professional and explains the policy. The low overall review count is typical for a specialized local service business.
fake_signals: One review is an owner response to a complaint, not a customer review
Low total review volume makes patterns harder to assess
authentic_signals: Specific project details (pump, valves, heater, cleaner)
Mix of praise and minor constructive feedback (scheduling)
Emotionally authentic language in both positive and negative reviews
Owner provided a detailed, factual response to a complaint
complaint_patterns: High service call fee for simple fix
data.discrepancy_explanation: Limited review data shows consistent, moderate ratings. BBB A+ rating with no complaints aligns with positive Google reviews.
